verses.en: And it was told Joab, Behold, the king weepeth and mourneth for Absalom.
verses.sm: Ioapo, Faauta, o loo tagi ma faanoanoa le tupu ia Apisaloma.

verses.en: And the victory that day was turned into mourning unto all the people: for the people heard say that day how the king was grieved for his son.
verses.sm: Ona avea lea o le manumalo i lea aso ma mea e faanoanoa ai i le nuu uma; auā ua faalogo le nuu i lea aso, ua faapea, Ua tiga le tupu ona o lona atalii.

verses.en: And the people gat them by stealth that day into the city, as people being ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.
verses.sm: Ua o faagaoi le nuu i lea aso i le aai, e pei ona O faagaoi le nuu ua masiasi ina ua sosola i le taua.

verses.en: But the king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, O my son Absalom, O Absalom, my son, my son!
verses.sm: Ua ufiufi e le tupu ona fofoga; ua alaga foi le tupu ua leo tele, Loʻu atalii Apisaloma e! Apisaloma lo'u atalii e, loʻu atalii e!

verses.en: And Joab came into the house to the king, and said, Thou hast shamed this day the faces of all thy servants, which this day have saved thy life, and the lives of thy sons and of thy daughters, and the lives of thy wives, and the lives of thy concubines;
verses.sm: Ona ulufale atu lea o Toapo i le tupu, ua fai atu, Ua e faamaina i le aso nei o au auauna uma lava, e ua laveai ia te oe i lenei aso, ma ou atalii, atoa ma ou afafine, ma Ou faletua, ma au palake,

verses.en: In that thou lovest thine enemies, and hatest thy friends. For thou hast declared this day, that thou regardest neither princes nor servants: for this day I perceive, that if Absalom had lived, and all we had died this day, then it had pleased thee well.
verses.sm: ina ua e alofa i e ʻinoʻino ia te oe, ma e ‘ʻinoʻino i e alofa ia te oe; aua ua e faaali mai i lenei aso, e leai sou manatu i ni alii ma auauna; aua ua Ou iloa i lenei aso, ana ola Apisaloma, a E oti i matou uma i le aso, po ua lelei lea ia te oe.

verses.en: Now therefore arise, go forth, and speak comfortably unto thy servants: for I swear by the LORD, if thou go not forth, there will not tarry one with thee this night: and that will be worse unto thee than all the evil that befell thee from thy youth until now.
verses.sm: O lenei, tulai ia, ma e maliu atu, ma faamatalaloto i au auauna; aua ou te tauto i le ALII, afai e te le maliu atu, e leai se tasi lua te nonofo i le po nanei; e sili ona leaga lea ia te oe i mea leaga uma ua Oo ia te oe talu ona e taulealea e 00 i le aso nei.

verses.en: Then the king arose, and sat in the gate. And they told unto all the people, saying, Behold, the king doth sit in the gate. And all the people came before the king: for Israel had fled every man to his tent.
verses.sm: Ona tulai lea o le tupu, ma nofo i le faitotoa; ua latou faailoa atu i le nuu uma, ua faapea, Faauta, o loo nofo le tupu à le faitotoa; ona o mai lea o le nuu uma i luma o le tupu. A o Isaraelu, ua taitasi ma sola i lona fale ie.

verses.en: And all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, The king saved us out of the hand of our enemies, and he delivered us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he is fled out of the land for Absalom.
verses.sm: Sa ¡aii le nuu uma le finauga i itu aiga uma o Isaraelu, ua faapea, Na laveai le tupu ia i tatou, ai lima o e ita mai ia i tatou, ua laveai foi o ia ia i tatou ai lima o Filisitia, ao lenei, ua sola o ia ai le nuu ona o Apisaloma;

verses.en: And Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why speak ye not a word of bringing the king back?
verses.sm: o Apisaloma foi na tatou faauuina e pule ia i tatou, ua oti o ia i le taua; o lenei o le a le mea tou te le tautalatala ai e faafoisia mai le tupu?

verses.en: And king David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, Speak unto the elders of Judah, saying, Why are ye the last to bring the king back to his house? seeing the speech of all Israel is come to the king, even to his house.
verses.sm: Ona aauina atu lea nisi e Tavita le tupu ia Satoka ma Aviata o faitaulaga, ua faapea, Lua te tautala atu i toeaina o Iuta, ia faapea, O le a le mea e tau mulimuli ai outou ona faafoisia O le tupu i lona fale? aua ua oo lava i le tupu i lona fale le fetalaiga a Isaraelu uma.

verses.en: Ye are my brethren, ye are my bones and my flesh: wherefore then are ye the last to bring back the king?
verses.sm: O°u uso outou, oʻu ivi ma oʻu aano lava outou; o le a lava le mea e tau mulimuli ai outou ona faafoisia o le tupu?

verses.en: And say ye to Amasa, Art thou not of my bone, and of my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if thou be not captain of the host before me continually in the room of Joab.
verses.sm: Lua te fai atu foi ia Amase, E le o oʻu ivi ma oʻu aano lava oe? la faapea ona faia e le Atua ia te au, ma ia faapea ona faaopoopo i ai, pe afai e le fai oe ma pule i “au! oʻu luma i aso uma e sui a'i loapo.

verses.en: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as the heart of one man; so that they sent this word unto the king, Return thou, and all thy servants.
verses.sm: Ua ia faauai mai loto o tagata uma o Iuta pei o se tagata e toatasi; ua latou feau mai i le tupu, Ina foi mai ia oe ma au auauna uma.

verses.en: So the king returned, and came to Jordan. And Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to conduct the king over Jordan.
verses.sm: Ona toe foi ai lea o le tupu, ua 00 i Ioritana; ona o mai lea o Iuta i Kilikala e faafetaiai i le tupu, e sopoia atu Ioritana ma le tupu.

verses.en: And Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite, which was of Bahurim, hasted and came down with the men of Judah to meet king David.
verses.sm: Ua faataalise Semi le atalii o Kira, le sa Peniamina, le Pauri, ona alu ifo lea o ia faatasi ma tagata o Iuta e faafetaiai ia Tavita le tupu,

verses.en: And there were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went over Jordan before the king.
verses.sm: ma tagata e toaafe faatasi ma ia mai Peniamina; atoa ma Sipa le auauna a le aiga o Saulo, ma ona atalii e toasefulu ma le toalima, ma ana auauna e toaluafulu faatasi ma ia; ua latou sopoia atu Ioritana i luma o le tupu.

verses.en: And there went over a ferry boat to carry over the king's household, and to do what he thought good. And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king, as he was come over Jordan;
verses.sm: Ua alu ane le vaa e tautuu ai le aiga o le tupu, ma fai mea ua finagalo i ai o ia; ona faapaú lea o Semi le atalii o Kira i luma o le tupu, ina ua sopoia atu e ia Ioritana.

verses.en: And said unto the king, Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me, neither do thou remember that which thy servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.
verses.sm: Ua ia fai mai foi i le tupu, Aua le tauia mai laʻu agasala e loʻu alii; aua le manatu foi i le mea na agaleaga ai lau auauna, i le aso na afio mai ai lo'u alii le tupu mai Ierusalema, ina neʻi faalotoloto i ai o le tupu.

verses.en: For thy servant doth know that I have sinned: therefore, behold, I am come the first this day of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.
verses.sm: Aua ua iloa e lau auauna ua ou agasala lava au; silasila mai foi, ua Ou sau, ua ou muamua mai i le aiga o Iosefa uma lava, ou te alu ifo e faafetaiai i lo‘u alii le tupu.

verses.en: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said, Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD'S anointed?
verses.sm: Ona tali ane ai lea o Apisai le tama a Seruia, ua faapea ane, E le o le mea lava lea ea, o le a oti ai Semi? aua na ia fetuu i le ua faauuina e le ALII.

verses.en: And David said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah, that ye should this day be adversaries unto me? shall there any man be put to death this day in Israel? for do not I know that I am this day king over Israel?
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Tavita, O le a ea la oulua na ia te au, o Oulua le fanau a Seruia? aua e fai oulua ma e faalavelave mai ia te au i lenei aso; e fasiotia ea se tasi i le aso nei i Isaraelu? Auā e le ua ou iloa ea, o aʻu lava le tupu o Isaraelu i le aso nei?

verses.en: Therefore the king said unto Shimei, Thou shalt not die. And the king sware unto him.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o le tupu ia Semi, E te le oti oe; ua tauto ai foi le tupu ia te ia.

verses.en: And Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king, and had neither dressed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came again in peace.
verses.sm: Ua alu ifo foi Mefiposeta le atalii o Saulo e faafetaiai i le tupu, na ia le teua ona vae, ua le teua foi lana ‘ava, ma ona ofu ua na le taia talu mai le aso na alu atu ai le tupu, e oo i le aso na sau ai ma le filemu.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when he was come to Jerusalem to meet the king, that the king said unto him, Wherefore wentest not thou with me, Mephibosheth?
verses.sm: Ua alu atu o ia i Ierusalema e faafetaiai i le tupu; ona fai atu lea o le tupu ia te ia, Mefiposeta e, se a le mea na ta le o ai ma a‘u?

verses.en: And he answered, My lord, O king, my servant deceived me: for thy servant said, I will saddle me an ass, that I may ride thereon, and go to the king; because thy servant is lame.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai o ia, Lo'u alii e le tupu, na pelogia aʻu e laʻu auauna; auā na fai ane lau auauna, Ou te faanofoaina le asini mo aʻu, ou te tietie ai, ma ou alu atu i le tupu; auā ua pipili lau auauna.

verses.en: And he hath slandered thy servant unto my lord the king; but my lord the king is as an angel of God: do therefore what is good in thine eyes.
verses.sm: Ua tuuaʻiina fua lau auauna i loʻu alii le tupu; a e tusa loʻu alii le tupu ma se agelu a le Atua; o lenei, fai ia se mea e te finagalo i ai;

verses.en: For all of my father's house were but dead men before my lord the king: yet didst thou set thy servant among them that did eat at thine own table. What right therefore have I yet to cry any more unto the king?
verses.sm: auā sa leai se tasi i le aiga uma o loʻu tamā, na O tagata e tatau ona Oti i luma o loʻu alii le tupu, a ua e tofia lau auauna faatasi ma e aai i lau lava laoai; se a sa'u mea e toe tatau ai ona ou toe tagi atu ai i le tupu?

verses.en: And the king said unto him, Why speakest thou any more of thy matters? I have said, Thou and Ziba divide the land.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o le tupu ia te ia, Se a le mea e te toe fai mai ai i au mea? ua Ou fai atu, o oe ma Sipa lua te vaeluaina le fanua.

verses.en: And Mephibosheth said unto the king, Yea, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king is come again in peace unto his own house.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai Mefiposeta i le tupu, Ave pea ia mea uma lava ma ia; tau ina ua oo mai lo'u alii le tupu ma le manuia i lona fale.

verses.en: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim, and went over Jordan with the king, to conduct him over Jordan.
verses.sm: O Pasili foi le Kiliata, ua alu ifo o ia nai Rokeli; ua la sopoia atu Ioritana, ma le tupu ina ia momoli ia te ia i Ioritana.

verses.en: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even fourscore years old: and he had provided the king of sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim; for he was a very great man.
verses.sm: Ua matuā toeaina lava Pasili, ua valugafulu ona tausaga; o ia lava na fagaina le tupu ina O nofo o ia i Maanaima, aua o le alii tele lava o ia.

verses.en: And the king said unto Barzillai, Come thou over with me, and I will feed thee with me in Jerusalem.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o le tupu ia Pasili, Ta te o ma au, ta te mafuta faatasi ma a‘u i Ierusalema.

verses.en: And Barzillai said unto the king, How long have I to live, that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem?
verses.sm: A ua fai mai Pasili i le tupu, E fia ni aso o tausaga o loʻu olaga o totoe, ta te o ae ai ma oe le tupu i Ierusalema?

verses.en: I am this day fourscore years old: and can I discern between good and evil? can thy servant taste what I eat or what I drink? can I hear any more the voice of singing men and singing women? wherefore then should thy servant be yet a burden unto my lord the king?
verses.sm: Ua valugafulu o'u tausaga i lenei aso; e iloa ea e a‘u se lelei ma se leaga? e lagona ea e lau auauna ni aʻu mea e ‘ai ma ni au mea e inu? ou te toe lagona ea le leo O tane pepese ma fafine pepese? Se a le mea e toe faatiga ai loʻu alii le tupu e lau auauna?

verses.en: Thy servant will go a little way over Jordan with the king: and why should the king recompense it me with such a reward?
verses.sm: E momoli faaitiiti atu e lau auauna i le tupu i Ioritana; se a foi le mea a taui mai ai e le tupu i lena taw tele?

verses.en: Let thy servant, I pray thee, turn back again, that I may die in mine own city, and be buried by the grave of my father and of my mother. But behold thy servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good unto thee.
verses.sm: Seʻi toe foi lau auauna, seʻi ou oti i loʻu nuu e latalata ane i le tuugamau o loʻu tamā ma loʻu tina. Silasila foi o lau auauna o Kimeama, e alu atu o ia ma loʻu alii le tupu, e te faia ia te ia se mea e te finagalo i ai.

verses.en: And the king answered, Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good unto thee: and whatsoever thou shalt require of me, that will I do for thee.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o le tupu, Ma te O atu ma Kimeama; ou te faia foi ia te ia se mea e te loto i ai; o mea uma foi e te fai mai ai ia te au ou te faia lava mo oe.

verses.en: And all the people went over Jordan. And when the king was come over, the king kissed Barzillai, and blessed him; and he returned unto his own place.
verses.sm: Ona sopoia atu lea e le nuu uma i Ioritana; ua alu atu ai foi ie tupu, ona feasogi lea o le tupu ma Pasili, ma ua faamanuia ia te ia; ona toe foi lea o ia i lona nuu.

verses.en: Then the king went on to Gilgal, and Chimham went on with him: and all the people of Judah conducted the king, and also half the people of Israel.
verses.sm: Ona alu atu lea o le tupu i Kilikala, o Kimeama foi na la o ma ia. O le nuu uma o Iuta na latou o ma le tupu, atoa ma le vaeluagalemu o le nuu O Isaraelu.

verses.en: And, behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said unto the king, Why have our brethren the men of Judah stolen thee away, and have brought the king, and his household, and all David's men with him, over Jordan?
verses.sm: Faauta foi, o tagata uma o Isaraelu, na o mai i latou i le tupu, ua latou fai mai i le tupu, O le a le mea na faagaoi ai ia te oe e o matou uso, O tagata o Iuta, ma ua latou au mai le tupu ma lona aiga i loritana, atoa ma tagata uma o Tavita faatasi ma ia?

verses.en: And all the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, Because the king is near of kin to us: wherefore then be ye angry for this matter? have we eaten at all of the king's cost? or hath he given us any gift?
verses.sm: Ona tali atu lea o tagata uma o Iuta i tagata o Isaraelu, Aua ma te aiga ma le tupu; o le a le mea e te ita ai i lenei mea? Ua matou “aina ea ni mea a le tupu? po ua au mai e ia se alofa ia i matou?

verses.en: And the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more right in David than ye: why then did ye despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king? And the words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.
verses.sm: Ona tali atu lea o tagata o Isaraelu i tagata o luta, ua faapea atu, E sefulu oʻu itu aiga i le tupu; e sili foi Tavita ia te au, a e itiiti ia te oe; o le a lava le mea ua e faaletaualoa ai aʻu, ma ua le muai ta'u mai 3a te au, e faafoisia mai loʻu tupu? Ua sili ona mamafa le upu a tagata o Tuta i le upu a tagata o Isaraelu.
